penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: An LWC managed package or AppExchange utility requires Salesforce-certified development, deployment to scratch orgs, and per-customer installation support — not automatable by Claude.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: ISV and enterprise Salesforce sales cycles involve demos, security reviews, and procurement conversations that require human involvement.

rationale: Salesforce developers hit this multi-parentId wire API ceiling regularly and the workaround (custom Apex) is a genuine recurring cost in every affected org, making the pain real and the buyer identifiable (Salesforce developer/architect). However, the solution is a Salesforce managed package or LWC utility — requiring Apex/JavaScript development, Salesforce DX tooling, AppExchange security review, and governor-limit expertise — none of which Claude can build or deliver. Ongoing support for a Salesforce package also requires platform-certified human judgment per deployment. This is a developer-tools infrastructure play, not a Claude-factory play.
solution_plan: This is not viable for this factory. Building a Salesforce LWC utility/managed package requires certified Salesforce development skills (Apex, LWC, SOQL), AppExchange security review, and per-org deployment support. Claude cannot generate or maintain production Salesforce packages autonomously. A solo non-technical operator cannot build or sell this without a Salesforce-certified developer partner. File as market validation for a future collaboration opportunity and do not invest further.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai (3 < 6 floor) and operational_autonomy (3 < 7 floor) build gates. Penalties bring total to 2.2, well below validate threshold. Drop.
